author: TheChosenGuy1
body:
Hey Guys!

Chosen here, For most of you who don't know me, I used to be a huge map maker about two years ago on Xbox, and then moved over to PC making custom maps and my original Mole Elf Human game-mode on my YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zTKMJD0VoXQ (pardon the video, it was my very first ever video of the sort on a lower quality system) But you get the idea of some of the projects I've built. 

Well, I decided to start again and this time make maps for tournament usage and casual play for Avicus. This first map is called Aquarius. Originally, this map was made strictly to be a Capture the Wool map, however after I finished the project I realized that it could also work for DTM. That is with minor adjustments of course. Attached are some photos of the map so people can evaluate and give their opinion. It's my first map of this sort and the only problem I noticed was the Wool Rooms are in a weird spot, but I think it works great either way. Photo Set:
http://imgur.com/a/LJzml  UPDATED VERSION: http://imgur.com/a/1DQK2
As you can see the map has a "Water" theme. and the chests in the wool room would have Depth Strider I Iron boots in them, and Punch I bows.


If you like the map, checking out other maps I made on my channel would make me really happy! Thank you guys and I'll have more coming as the weeks go on.

replies.body:
A work in progress! I like the theme.

I like the pirate ship spawn,

One thing is to make more pvp grounds. Group some of the islands together and make one larger island for pvp. Also maybe add some structures above the islands to make them not seem so plain. Like pillars, so bow fights can last longer. Or something themed that wont make the islands boring.
